title: American Chocolate Pie
description: A rich and decadent pie filled with a velvety chocolate filling. This gluten-free dessert is perfect for satisfying your sweet tooth.

ingredients.name: crust
ingredients.notes: Make sure to choose a gluten-free crust.

instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place it in a 9-inch pie dish.
In a medium saucepan over low heat, melt the chocolate chips and cream, stirring occasionally.
Once melted, remove from heat and stir in the sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Pour the chocolate mixture into the pie crust.
Bake for 45-50 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly.
Let cool to room temperature before serving.
